rejection_summary.title: The Trap (Die Falle)
rejection_summary.reason: Netflix confirms all six episodes release October 13, 2026, after this research date. The sister-murder bait-and-cat-and-mouse premise is promising, but there is no completed-season evidence yet to establish meaningful revelation frequency and progressive revelation; do not score from the trailer or source novel.

rejection_summary.title: Below
rejection_summary.reason: The six-part Netflix sea-creature thriller premieres October 8, 2026, but the currently consulted launch reviews and promotional material emphasize the creature/horror premise, not independently substantiated revelations distributed through all six episodes. Whole-season revelation cadence and all required DNA dimensions are not sufficiently established for a candidate today.

rejection_summary.title: American Sweatshop
rejection_summary.reason: A social-media moderator investigates a violent video, but whole-film synopsis and mixed critical/audience reactions indicate repeated dead ends, deterioration of the protagonist, and a late ambiguous encounter rather than a well-paced series of meaningful answers. Some reviewers find the script shallow or the payoff disappointing; this is investigation and psychological distress without sufficiently reliable progressive-revelation evidence for the current research candidate set.
